    Get a table, e.g. variables (or measurement types)

    get_table.Rd

    Get a table, e.g. variables (or measurement types)

    get_table(
  x,
  table_name = "ts",
  vfilter = NULL,
  data.table = (table_name != "p"),
  sf = (table_name == "p"),
  ...
)

    Arguments

    x

    database or dateset, e.g like db

    table_name

    variable table name

    vfilter

    (possible) character string containg the filtering condition. See dplyr::filter.

    data.table

    logical option. If TUE returns a data.table object

    sf

    logical option. If TRUE returns a sf object.

    ...

    further arguments

    Examples

    
data(db)
table <- get_table(x=db)
#>               ID attribute_id variable_id timestamptz  p_id value attrvalue
#>            <int>        <int>       <int>      <POSc> <int> <num>    <char>
